beats.headline: Announced in an area message
beats.text: The Madre de Aguas is dead. That is the first thing the area message says. The second is that she has risen as a zombie, and the third, in the very same breath, is my name: the major demon Amayon, demon prince of Sheol, come into this realm to possess her. I could not have written the announcement better myself. Everyone in range heard it. Good. A prince should not have to introduce himself.

beats.headline: Where the Sidewalk Ends
beats.text: The regional quest they are handed describes me with some accuracy. A level 250 demon lord, one of the four princes of Sheol, betrayed by a brother and holding on by a ledge, in the body of a once-worshipped sea serpent. To go home I must cast, and nobody rides the river for free: my portal will inhale every soul in Cuba, and that will be barely enough. Something is thwarting me. They may do nothing and be swept up in two hours, free me from this shell, or kill me. I am invulnerable on this floor.

beats.headline: Out of the snake, still hers
beats.text: The ceiling of their hallway collapses around my coils, and the automaton lands on me, and I am teleported out of the Madre de Aguas. In the open air I take my true form, four feet in the street, chest level with their new roof. The marker over my head still says Enslaved. The quest they are handed calls Ysalte my former girlfriend and the mother of my child, and says she has seized me as I once seized her. She means to take me to the Ascendency as her retainer. I am given six totems, and I will not begin to flee until every one of them is dead.

beats.headline: A question from Emberus
beats.text: The man stands in my palm and says he carries a question from Emberus, about his son. The doll supplies the name: Geyrun, murdered. I laugh. I know exactly what happened; I witnessed the deal being signed, and if Emberus helps me kill my three brothers, I will tell him. The man says he gave me the strength and the souls, and asks me to call off my demons in exchange for carrying my message. But he also helped slay Ysalte, the mother of my child, so we are even. Speaking to him delivered the message. I turn my hand over and let them fall toward the fire.

beats.headline: A timer on a global teleport
beats.text: Their quest, the Missing Piece, updates. Succeeded, it says. And beneath the word, a timer, one for each region, counting down to the moment my spell goes off there. A global teleport. When it lands, the walls of their stairwell chambers will be sucked away, and anyone crouched beneath them pulled upward into the stairwell. They wanted me casting. They have their wish. Home is the direction I am going in any case, and I have never minded company on the road.
